dialogues.speaker: Susie
dialogues.text: May the Wind of Mondstadt always be with you.

dialogues.speaker: Susie
dialogues.text: I am just like you, one that is blessed by Barbatos, the Anemo Archon.

dialogues.speaker: Susie
dialogues.text: Shouldn't we show our gratitude to Barbatos for the wind and warmth?

dialogues.speaker: Susie
dialogues.text: Mondstadt is a city blessed by the Anemo Archon Barbatos.

dialogues.speaker: Susie
dialogues.text: The wind blowing on Mondstadt is Barbatos' blessing.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are there any places worth visiting in the city?

dialogues.speaker: Susie
dialogues.text: If you want to learn more about Barbatos, make sure to visit the Mondstadt Cathedral.

dialogues.speaker: Susie
dialogues.text: It's said that Barbatos' sacred instrument, the Holy Lyre der Himmel, is enshrined in the Cathedral.

dialogues.speaker: Susie
dialogues.text: Goodbye, the one blessed by the Anemo Archon. May the Wind of Mondstadt always be with you.

dialogues.speaker: Susie
dialogues.text: Why did such a thing happen to Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Susie
dialogues.text: Did I not pray earnestly enough?

dialogues.speaker: Susie
dialogues.text: ...No, it has to be someone else. I always pray with all my heart...
